audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was Urgot's on this page while the mirror gives that stage to Sylas.
audit.why: The mirror audit (sylas vs urgot) flipped row 4 to Sylas in both layers with the rating inverted; Hijack at 80s rank 1 copying your execute is what decides that stage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Sylas's stage. Levels 1-5 and first item stay as they are.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike with a 25% execute number and only a passing note that he steals your R.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s at 950 range — shorter than your own 100s R at rank 1, so he can copy Fear Beyond Death and use it more often than you get it back. Riot gives no numeric execute threshold.
audit.corrected: Cast Fear Beyond Death outside his 950 range: Hijack is 80s at rank 1 and hands him your execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond/Abduct is described as 'his dash + stun (recast pull)' — there is no stun, and the recast pulls Sylas to the target, not the target to him.
audit.why: Riot's E text: Sylas dashes to a location, and can recast to throw his chains, pulling HIMSELF to an enemy he hits. No stun appears in the text. It is 13/12/11/10/9s at 400 range. Kingslayer (12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, 400 range) is the heal that Grievous Wounds answers.
audit.corrected: Abscond is a 13s dash with no stun; the recast drags him to you. Bait it, then commit inside that window.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Sylas is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Hijack is 80s at rank 1 and steals Fear Beyond Death straight off you — never cast your R inside his 950 range.

edits.before: Your R flips him if he Abducts in, cashing the lead at 6.
edits.after: Level 6 is his; Hijack takes Fear Beyond Death off you.

edits.before: R Fear Beyond Death flips a Sylas who dashes in with Abduct — and note his ult steals YOUR R, so keep him too low to want to trade ultimates in the first place.
edits.after: Hijack is only 80s at rank 1 and it copies Fear Beyond Death — cast yours outside his 950 range, or he takes the execute and points it straight back at you.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct: 13s at rank 1, 400 range. The recast pulls HIM to you — there is no stun on it. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is a dash with no stun — the recast drags him to you. Bait it at 13s, then commit.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sylas carry threat: 7/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sylas carry threat: 7/10 — end before he cashes it.

notes: Hijack's 80s rank-1 cooldown is shorter than Fear Beyond Death's 100s, so trading ultimates with him is strictly losing — the page previously framed his steal as an afterthought. wants.foe[0] ('Land the Abduct pull to start a burst combo') is technically inverted since Abduct pulls Sylas in rather than pulling you, but it is short and reads acceptably from his side, so it was left alone rather than spending an edit.
